# English Wiktionary

> > A free, collaborative multilingual dictionary with comprehensive word definitions, etymology, and linguistic reference for all languages.

English Wiktionary is a community-driven, open-content dictionary project that provides definitions, pronunciations, etymologies, and thesaurus entries across multiple languages. The site leverages MediaWiki technology and operates under Creative Commons and GNU Free Documentation licenses, making it a freely accessible language resource for both human readers and language models.

## Key Topics

- Wiktionary
- multilingual dictionary
- etymology

## Getting Started

- [Wiktionary Main Page](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Homepage providing access to free multilingual dictionary with definitions, etymology, and thesaurus
- [Help Contents](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Help:Contents): Help documentation covering editing guides, wiki syntax, and entry creation basics
- [Appendix: Glossary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Appendix:Glossary): Glossary of grammatical and linguistic terminology for dictionary reference

## Community & Collaboration

- [Community Portal](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Community_portal): Community portal with discussion forums, contact channels, and collaboration guidelines
- [Contact Us](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Contact_us): Contact information and support channels for Wiktionary community and Wikimedia Foundation
- [Requested Entries](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Requested_entries): Multilingual word requests and community contribution guidelines for dictionary entries
- [Main Page Discussion](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary_talk:Main_Page): Discussion page for main page feedback, feature requests, and community discussion

## Content Organization & Navigation

- [All Languages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Category:All_languages): Language category index organizing multilingual entries by language families and scripts
- [All Topics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Category:All_topics): Topic classification system for semantic categorization of dictionary entries
- [Random Entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:Random): Random word entry generator displaying dictionary definitions and linguistic information

## Site Administration & Monitoring

- [Recent Changes](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Wiki monitoring tool tracking recent edits, vandalism patrol, and content review
- [Statistics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Statistics): Database metrics and language coverage statistics for English Wiktionary overview
- [Special Pages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:SpecialPages): Administrative tools for wiki maintenance, page management, and site organization
- [New Pages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:NewPages): New pages list with content filtering and administration tools for recent entries

## Optional

- [Site Statistics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:Statistics): Site analytics and statistics for page metrics, users, and edit activity
- [Pages Linking Here](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:WhatLinksHere/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Backlinks tool showing pages linking to the main page for wiki navigation
- [Related Changes](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:RecentChangesLinked/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Change tracking tool monitoring recent edits to linked pages and watchlists
- [Example Entry: free](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/free): Dictionary entry for 'free' with pronunciation, etymology, and linguistic definitions
